body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.72 (naive base rate 0.75) that: Caterpillar announces a quarterly dividend increase of ≥7% (to ≥$1.75) by 30-Jun-2027. Evidence: 8-K 11-Jun-2026: Board raised quarterly dividend by 12 cents (+8%) to $1.63, 'maintains our place on the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats Index'. Prior June raises (from memory): 2023 +8%, 2024 +8%, 2025 +7%. Q3 2026 8-K: $1.2B buybacks + $0.7B dividends in the quarter; enterprise cash $7.9B; operating cash flow $4.4B. Reasoning: Pattern is very stable and cash generation strong; the main risk is a smaller raise if the machinery cycle softens (rate hikes globally). Resolution: YES if, on or before 30-Jun-2027, Caterpillar declares a regular quarterly dividend ≥ $1.745 per share (rounded: ≥$1.75). Source: Caterpillar dividend 8-K / press release (SEC EDGAR, CIK 18230). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score with Brier vs base rate.

Model: worksheet scenarios bear 25%→0.68x, base 50%→1.64x, bull 20%→2.89x with σ=0.30; reverse DCF base-case IRR 8.7%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.58x anchored (raw 1.58x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the total-return multiple (adjusted close incl. dividends reinvested, splits/bonuses adjusted) from 2026-11-23 (entry INR 438.25) to the last close on or before 2031-11-23 is ≥ 3.0.
